/**
 * Calculates the sum of squares from 1 to n using a counter loop.
 * @param {number} n - The upper limit (inclusive)
 * @returns {number} The sum of squares (1² + 2² + 3² + ... + n²)
 */
function sumOfSquares(n) {
  if (n < 1) {
    return 0;
  }

  let sum = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    sum += i * i;
  }

  return sum;
}
```
